metric_convention: SERVED TTFT: admission -> first SSE token frame over the OpenAI /v1/chat/completions endpoint (includes tokenization + chunked prefill-bucket priming + first decode token + mux/SSE hop). Directly comparable to vLLM ttft_ms. Prefill runs the sm_120 _pf object (PLOW_NV_PREFILL=1, T3 cp.async GEMM); TPOT then runs the T=1 decode program per token.
run_mode: plowrt serve --features cuda,hf-tokenizer, batch 1, greedy, single user; gemma4-12b-pf.pkt (PLOW_UNISEG=1, 128k ctx, prefill buckets [128,512,1024,2048,4096,8192]+decode); interp_sm120.cubin + interp_sm120_pf.cubin. TTFT client-side over SSE; TPOT = measure_tpot.py mean over warm steps (16 discarded).
